note: The OLG has two relevant pages. The 'SSA COLA Overview' page (Scheduled Mailings > SSA COLA) acknowledges that SSA calculates annual COLAs for RSDI and SSI and that these 'can affect TAFDC, EAEDC, and SNAP benefits,' but provides no detail on how SNAP adjustments are processed, timing requirements, or worker responsibilities. It links to an 'SSA COLA Policy and Procedures' page (PandP/PP_SSACOLA.htm) that was not captured in the OLG scrape and may contain detailed procedures. The 'SNAP Annual COLA' page (Scheduled Mailings > SNAP COLA) covers USDA's annual adjustment of SNAP program parameters (deductions, income limits, benefit levels) and notes BEACON automatically recalculates active cases — but this is about SNAP standard changes, not about adjusting individual household benefits when their SSI/RSDI income changes due to a federal COLA. Key FNS requirements not found in available OLG content: (1) the mandate to automatically adjust SNAP benefits for households affected by federal mass changes; (2) the 'second allotment' timing deadline; (3) coverage of veterans assistance (Title 38) and Black Lung mass changes; (4) retrospective budgeting rules for mass changes. The missing 'SSA COLA Policy and Procedures' page may address some of these gaps, but based on available OLG content, the coverage is incomplete.
